_what: Brief 5 V1 ring station: camera maximising ConiferPine + SpruceSub in the 128-512 m ring, with NO tree within 15 m of the camera in frame (V1 clearance rule).
_method: top-25 densest card-species 256 m bins x yaw(0..350/10) x pitch{-5,0,5}; reject any camera with a tree < 15 m in the frustum; then count in-frustum ConiferPine+SpruceSub with 128 m <= d <= min(512 m, cull). Same frustum as derive_forest_station.
